blocks.text: UAAP SCHEDULE: Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—While Far Eastern University was waiting for its matchup with the University of the East in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament, rookie Cabs Cabonillas was on a separate mission. Following the Tamaraws’ season-opening loss to Adamson, the squad went on a long break while Cabonillas competed for Gilas Pilipinas in the Fiba 3×3 U23 World Cup in Wuhan, China. While the Gilas 3×3 troop was unable to secure a win in the Games, Cabonilas showed that he learned quite a lot. The former high school standout chipped in big […]...
